name: Mega Flare (Bahamut)
doc: Mega Flare (Bahamut) (enemy attack 234 Mega Flare): the GF cinematic engine's clone run from the two script files (mag256_b.00 / .01, its parameters) - its bones, prims, sprites and particles, the action results. The program calls the clone's own setup (the engine's state block is shared, one clone at a time), its root re-pointed at the program's director; the tick is the port's (FFNx mag257_mega_flare.cpp), the file loader ProgramFiles' (gfc_engine.h).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.
